# FDG5078

> CONSIDER defining extension methods in the same namespace as the extended type if the type is an interface and if the extension methods are meant to be used in most or all cases.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 5.6 Extension Methods.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library suggestion, application suggestion, test none
- Status: verified

Not checked: whether extension methods are meant for most or all uses is a design judgment. FDG5076 does not report extension methods on interfaces, the case this rule allows.
